ns2:course.label: Perf Pract November II
ns2:course.description: Performance laboratory involving the rehearsal and performance of works by faculty and visiting artists performed in November Dance. 1 to 3 undergraduate hours. 1 to 3 graduate hours. May be repeated to a maximum of 16 hours. Prerequisite: Consent of instructor.
